# @three-ws/loom-mcp

> Loom — the three.ws community 3D-creation gallery from any AI agent. Browse the public feed of community-forged GLB creations, fetch one with its viewer URL, and submit your own. Public API, no key required.

@three-ws/loom-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/loom-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/loom-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/loom-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/loom-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/loom-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
